methodology: Official NBK EUR/KZT rate, KZT per one EUR, weekdays (the rate in force on the day). From 1999-11-17: the NBK daily report (its first rows, 1999-10-19..21, are malformed). Accumulated: each run reads the last 45 days of the report and merges them with the processed history, which was loaded in full on 2026-09-25. No rate is published for 2023-07-28..2023-08-21. Before 1999-11-17: the NBK archive of official rates 1993-1999 (https://nationalbank.kz/file/download/22756), the rate in force on each weekday, from 1999-01-04; equal to the report on every common weekday 1999-11-17..1999-12-31 (enforced). No euro before 1999-01-04; the archive's ECU and Deutsche mark are not spliced in.
